title: qAI37 emerges from stealth with post-silicon memory architecture
description: qAI37 announced its vendor-agnostic software access point connecting conventional inference models directly to neutral-atom quantum memory states.

title: Japan brings online its first full-stack neutral-atom quantum computer
description: Japan's Institute for Molecular Science operationalized "Shunkai," the country's first full-stack neutral-atom quantum computer, built with Hitachi and Infleqtion.

title: Pasqal and Eleven Ventures form joint venture for the Middle East
description: Pasqal and Saudi investment platform Eleven Ventures announced a joint venture to deploy and scale neutral-atom quantum systems across Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region.

title: Oratomic closes $300M Series A
description: Oratomic raised a $300M Series A to advance its fault-tolerant, neutral-atom approach to quantum computing.

title: Atom Computing raises $100M Series C, signs Department of Commerce letter of intent
description: Atom Computing announced a $100M Series C round plus a signed $100M Letter of Intent with the U.S. Department of Commerce to accelerate its neutral-atom quantum computing work.

title: Google Quantum AI adds neutral-atom hardware to its roadmap
description: Google Quantum AI expanded its research program to include neutral-atom hardware, hiring physicist Adam Kaufman to lead a new team based in Boulder, Colorado.

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang describes the "inference inflection"
description: At Nvidia's GTC keynote, CEO Jensen Huang framed AI infrastructure economics around tokens produced per watt of power, describing a shift in AI compute demand from training to inference.
